questions.q: Thanos debuted in which series in 1973?
questions.why: Thanos made his debut in The Invincible Iron Man #55, dated February 1973.
Jim Starlin created Thanos for Marvel, and later shaped his best-known stories.

questions.q: In the comics, which world is Thanos from?
questions.why: Thanos is an Eternal-Deviant hybrid from Titan, a moon of Saturn.

questions.q: In the comics, whom does Thanos hope to woo with the power of the Infinity Gauntlet?
questions.why: His obsession with Mistress Death drives him to erase half of all life in Infinity Gauntlet.

questions.q: Which actor has played Thanos in the Marvel films since 2014?
questions.why: Josh Brolin plays Thanos, largely through motion capture, beginning with Guardians of the Galaxy in 2014.

questions.q: Which actor played Thanos in the 2012 film The Avengers?
questions.why: Damion Poitier played the Mad Titan before Brolin took over the role.

questions.q: Thanos's brother, who is also called Starfox, goes by which name?
questions.why: Eros, also known as Starfox, is Thanos's brother in the comics.

questions.q: How many Infinity Gems does Thanos collect in the comics' Infinity Gauntlet storyline?
questions.why: The Infinity Gauntlet story centres on six gems, which give Thanos near-total power.

questions.q: Which Jack Kirby villain from DC Comics was an influence on Thanos?
questions.why: Jim Starlin drew on Darkseid, though his first sketches looked more like Metron.

questions.q: In which year was the Infinity Gauntlet storyline published?
questions.why: In 1991's Infinity Gauntlet, Thanos erases half the universe's life before it is undone.
